content: === Introduction ===
Gaba or GABA may refer to:
=== Places ===
<info> Gąba, a village in Poland
<info> Jaba', Haifa, a village near Mount Carmel, Israel also known as Gaba
<info> Jab'a, a village in the West Bank, southwest of Jerusalem, also known as Gaba
<info> Gaba, ancient city in what is now Tel Shush
<info> Gaba, a Persian city located in what is now known as Isfahan
<info> Gaba, a suburb of Makindye, Kampala, Uganda, on the shores of Lake Victoria
<info> Gaba railway station on the Chinese Qingzang Railway
=== People ===
<info> Harold Gaba (1946–2009), American businessman
<info> Lester Gaba (1907–1987), American sculptor, writer and retail display designer
<info> Marianne Gaba (1939–2016), American model
<info> Milan Gába (fl. 1970s–1980s), Czechoslovak slalom canoeist
<info> Millind Gaba (born 1990), Indian musician and celebrity
<info> Mo Gaba (2006–2020), American sports superfan and radio personality
<info> Pierre Toura Gaba (1920–1998), Chadian politician and diplomat
<info> Gaba Kulka (born 1979), Polish artist
=== Biology ===

<info> γ-Aminobutyric acid or GABA, the main inhibitory neurotransmitter in the central nervous system
GABA receptor, a proteinaceous signalling molecule
